list_tool_rest_api: list all available MCP tools with server info via the /mcp-rest/tools/list endpoint
call_tool_rest_api: call a specific MCP tool with arguments via the /mcp-rest/tools/call endpoint
test_connection: test connection to a dynamically configured MCP server before adding it
test_tools_list: preview available tools from a dynamically configured MCP server before adding it
preview_openapi_tools: generate tool previews from an OpenAPI spec without creating an MCP server
